info.description: Read-only ERC-721/1155 NFT detail, owner and holder-quantity queries (shared 20/minute/workspace), native and curated USDT/USDC balances plus canonical ERC-6551 account resolution/inspection on Ethereum, BSC and Polygon PoS. ERC-6551 supports same-chain bindings only; proxy verification does not certify NFT existence, ownership, authorization or implementation safety. BSC tokens are Binance-Peg; Polygon USDT uses USDT0 and USDC is Circle-issued. Common balances returns three assets at one block or fails as a whole. Batch limit: 20/minute/workspace; ERC-6551 resolve/get share a separate 20/minute/workspace limit; general query limit: 60/minute. Free public preview, no paid fallback. Reference USD asset/contract prices with source timestamps, bounded cache and no executable-quote guarantee.
